method_card.mechanism: The ordered inputs are the supplied IMGT numbering map, then the deposited mmCIF structure. Map each of six IMGT CDRs onto positive-occupancy deposited coordinates of one annotated Fab heavy/light pair. 抗体、抗體、重輕鏈配對、CDR 覆蓋。
method_card.objective: Assess the observability of complementary regions of the supplied heavy/light variable domains in one public Fab deposition.
method_card.estimator: Cross-check deposition identity and chain/position map, then count CDR sites with observed coordinates against all numbered CDR sites. Preserve insertion labels, absent sites and chain roles.
method_card.training_data_lineage: Deterministic coordinate analysis; method performs no model fitting.

manifest.licence: GX release source; archive terms apply to supplied materials.
manifest.limitations: Requires compatible, source-attributed IMGT mapping and the corresponding deposited chains. Coverage is restricted to the declared pair and model. No binding, affinity or specificity estimate.
